machineProfile.description: id of a profile in ../readiness_gate.json machineProfiles; default ref-win11

driver.description: unit = vitest in npm run check; cli = llull CLI script; electron = pack 06 harness; fault = fault-injection runner (pack 04); install-vm = clean-VM matrix (pack 05); perf = perf corpus on a machine profile (pack 03); field = pilot evidence (pack 01); review = a recorded human review (e.g. legal, qualified engineer)

baseline.description: value measured today, with date in sources.md; omit when not measured

expected.description: reference value (quoted, derived or closed form)

target.description: budget set by the spec: a literal, or { op, value } with op in <=, <, >=, >, ==

source.description: source ids from sources.md (R1, S3…) or 'derived: <where>' or 'spec budget'

gating.description: true for grade A references, cited closed forms and spec budgets (grade target); false for grade B/C references

errorCode.description: stable code asserted by the case, when it asserts a refusal or a finding

plan.description: existing file, path relative to validation/: the plan, task script or procedure

test.description: repo-relative path of the test or runner to build (may not exist yet)

level.description: PRL this case gates when it differs from the pack's defaultLevel in ../readiness_gate.json
